limitations: Targeted hot/scan/return workload, not production traffic.
No-reuse control has timing variation despite identical cache hits; do not attribute all total-time differences to LFU.
Cumulative LFU has no decay and may retain obsolete hot prefixes.
Experimental selection sorts the free list; large-pool overhead and changing hotsets remain untested.
validation: See evidence/summary.json and PLAN.txt; full pytest suite was not run.

follow_up_A_Y.conclusion: No overall throughput advantage on full concurrent A-Y; identical per-request prefix reuse.
